prompt:
I'm going to travel from May 25 to June 29.
First, I'm going to Halle (Saale), Germany.

During my travel I want to visit Italy (Florence, Rom, Pisa, Capri, Milan), Switzerland (Lugano), Netherlands (Amesterdam, Maastricht), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), France (Paris, Lyon), Germany (Berlin, Dresden) and Prague.

From May 25-May 29 I want to stay in Halle (Saale), Dresden, Leipzig and Berlin.

I want to visit Prague for only two days, only from June 14-June 16.

After visiting Milan, I want to go Lugano straight and come back to Milan.

I also don't want to visit Venice.

I want to have three days in Paris.

I want to go to the Netherlands from either Paris or Berlin.

On June 27 I want to go back to Halle.

Help me to plan my travel.
answer:
This route fits all your destinations and fixed dates, with **Prague on June 14–16, three nights in Paris, a Milan–Lugano–Milan day trip, and a return to Halle on June 27**.

Dates below mean arrival on the first date and departure on the last. I’ve interpreted your Prague stay as **two nights**, arriving June 14 and leaving June 16.

| Dates | Stay | Suggested plan |
|---|---|---|
| **May 25–27** | **Halle (Saale)** — 2 nights | Arrive and settle in on May 25. Visit **Leipzig as a day trip on May 26**, returning to Halle. |
| **May 27–28** | **Dresden** — 1 night | Train from Halle. Explore the old town, Frauenkirche and the Elbe waterfront. |
| **May 28–30** | **Berlin** — 2 nights | Train from Dresden. Spend May 29 sightseeing in Berlin. This covers your four initial German cities during May 25–29. |
| **May 30–June 1** | **Amsterdam** — 2 nights | Travel from Berlin by train or plane. You enter the Netherlands directly from Berlin, as requested. |
| **June 1–2** | **Maastricht** — 1 night | Train from Amsterdam. Enjoy the historic centre and riverside. |
| **June 2–5** | **Paris** — 3 nights | Train via Belgium. You’ll have roughly three days across your arrival afternoon, two full days and departure morning. |
| **June 5–7** | **Lyon** — 2 nights | High-speed train from Paris. Explore Vieux Lyon, Fourvière and the food scene. |
| **June 7–10** | **Barcelona** — 3 nights | Travel by train where a suitable service is available, or fly. Allow two full sightseeing days. |
| **June 10–14** | **Madrid** — 4 nights | High-speed train from Barcelona. Visit the Prado, Royal Palace and Retiro; optionally take a Toledo day trip. |
| **June 14–16** | **Prague** — 2 nights | Fly from Madrid on June 14. Explore that afternoon and June 15; depart June 16. |
| **June 16–19** | **Rome** — 3 nights | Fly from Prague. Divide your sightseeing between ancient Rome, the historic centre and the Vatican. |
| **June 19–21** | **Capri** — 2 nights | Train from Rome to Naples, then ferry to Capri. Staying overnight gives you quieter mornings and evenings. |
| **June 21–24** | **Florence** — 3 nights | Ferry to Naples, then train to Florence. Visit **Pisa as a day trip on June 23**. |
| **June 24–27** | **Milan** — 3 nights | Train from Florence. On **June 25, go straight from Milan to Lugano and return to Milan that evening**. Explore Milan on June 26. |
| **June 27–29** | **Halle (Saale)** — 2 nights | Return from Milan on June 27. Spend June 28 in Halle before your trip ends June 29. |

**Transport and booking priorities**

- **Book the fixed connections first:** Madrid–Prague on June 14, Prague–Rome on June 16, and Milan–Germany on June 27. Flight schedules depend on your travel year.
- **For the June 27 return**, compare flights to Berlin or Frankfurt followed by a train to Halle. An all-train journey from Milan is possible but takes most of the day and requires connections.
- **Keep your Milan accommodation during Lugano.** Take only a day bag; direct trains generally take about 1¼ hours each way.
- **Allow most of June 21 for Capri–Florence travel.** Ferry conditions can affect timing, so leave a generous margin before your train from Naples.
- Reserve major attractions ahead, especially the Vatican Museums, Colosseum, Uffizi, Accademia and Sagrada Família.

The main compromise is Paris: **three nights gives you two full days plus partial arrival and departure days**. For three completely uninterrupted sightseeing days, leave Maastricht early on June 2 and travel to Lyon late on June 5. Venice is excluded throughout.
